name: premium-seat-covers
description: Bilingual (EN/HI) website and admin for a premium car seat-cover manufacturer. Monorepo: apps/web, services/api, packages/shared.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @pcs/api" "npm run dev -w @pcs/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pcs/api && npm run build -w @pcs/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @pcs/api && npm run typecheck -w @pcs/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @pcs/api && npm run test -w @pcs/web
